items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Chippard; the name is only mentioned by the interviewer in a narrative context about who lived where.

ctx.x: No, no, no. St. Claude, no. St. Claude. St. Bernard. St. Claude. St. Claude. St. Claude. St. Claude.

St. Claude. I can't call that man's name too. name right. He and Chippard lived almost in the sand block at one time. We'll run across the name someplace. I'm trying to say that but I know it's good. I know the boy's good. He's working with me. You? I can't call the boy's name. Just about a minute left on here. Can you think of anything else about your life you'd like to tell or the old bands that you've played with? Either one of you? I'm more clear than I've told you before. I think you've covered everything…
She played with Tuxedo and Papa Celestan. She played with Papa Celestan and Buddy P.T. The one I know, she played with Ike Morgan. She played with them.
